as_5e41e6fe.summary: A sudden storm hits the jungle and blows Rory the lion cub's friend Naya the parrot into the highest tree. Despite his fear, Rory climbs through wind and rain to reach her and carries her down to safety as the other animals watch.
as_5e41e6fe.description: A small lion cub rescues his parrot friend trapped in a tree during a jungle storm. An animated tale about courage and helping others.
